visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A toddler boy with short dark hair, wearing a light beige quilted pajama suit, stands in a brightly lit living room with wooden floors. He looks down at the ground with a somber expression. A small circular inset at the bottom left shows a young woman with dark hair smiling and talking to the camera. The background features a white kitchen island and a black shelf unit against a white wall. (2) The toddler sits down on the wooden floor and begins playing with several colorful pink, red, and yellow plastic blocks. He looks directly up at the camera with an intense, slightly pouting facial expression, holding a red block in his right hand. The lighting is bright and natural, likely from a nearby window. Large white text overlays with black borders appear at the top of the frame. (3) The scene cuts to a low-angle shot as the boy lies face down on the wooden floor in a dramatic pose, spreading his arms and legs out. He is surrounded by his colorful blocks. The mother's face in the inset continues to provide narration, while a cartoonish graphic or variety text appears near the child. The wooden floor reflects the soft overhead lighting. (4) The boy suddenly lifts his head, his eyes widening in surprise as if he heard his name. He begins to crawl rapidly across the wooden floor towards the camera with a determined look. In the background, a large brown suitcase and a modern white fireplace become visible. The camera pans smoothly to follow his forward movement as he reaches out with his hands. (5) The toddler stands up and walks towards the kitchen counter, holding a pink block. He approaches a woman's hand reaching out to receive it. The scene transitions to the kitchen countertop, which is white marble and holds a plate with scrambled eggs, green vegetables, and pink shrimp. The mother's inset remains, and she appears to be eating while interacting with the boy.
